claims.claim: Meta's second quarter 2026 revenue grew 28% year over year, alongside increased costs and expenses.
Revenue for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 was $60.80 billion.
Revenue in the prior year period (Q2 2025) was $47.52 billion.
Net income was $15.85 billion, a decrease from $18.34 billion in the second quarter of 2025.
Diluted EPS was $6.18, compared to $7.14 in the second quarter of 2025.
Total costs and expenses were $42.03 billion.
Costs and expenses include $2.40 billion of charges related to legal proceedings.
Costs and expenses include $1.18 billion of severance expenses from the May 2026 headcount reduction.
Free cash flow, a non-GAAP measure, was $784 million.
Family of Apps revenue was $60.37 billion.
Reality Labs revenue was $431 million.
Reality Labs reported an operating loss of $4.62 billion for the quarter.
Ad impressions across the Family of Apps increased 14% year over year.
Average price per ad increased 12% year over year.
Family daily active people (DAP) averaged 3.60 billion for June 2026.
Third quarter 2026 total revenue is expected to be in the range of $61-64 billion.
Full year 2026 total expenses are expected to be in the range of $165-169 billion.
2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, are anticipated to be in the range of $130-145 billion.
The tax rate for the remaining quarters of 2026 is expected to be between 15-17%.
The company expects to deliver operating income this year that is above 2025 operating income.
Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $90.26 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Long-term debt was $83.66 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $31.08 billion for the quarter.
Dividend and dividend equivalent payments were $1.35 billion.
The company notes that youth-related trials scheduled for this year in the U.S. may ultimately result in a material loss.
Approximately 8,000 employees impacted by the May 2026 headcount reduction are still included in the reported headcount of 75,472.
Foreign currency is assumed to be an approximately 1% headwind to year-over-year total revenue growth in the third quarter.
